title: Iterated doubling loop
statement: For a Boolean list $z$, define the output by iterating the conditional doubling step $2(|z|+1)^1$ times, starting from the pair encoding of $[\mathrm{true}]$ and the list formed by prefixing `false` to the first component of the default first-pair decomposition of the output of the counting loop on $z$.
caveat: The supplied statement does not define the pair encoding, pair decomposition, or counting loop, so these components cannot be given self-contained mathematical meanings.
